title: Q15
description:
“For yet a little while, and He who is coming will come and will not tarry. Now the just shall live by faith.”
Read: Hab 2:1–4
a) In Habakkuk, the *vision* will surely come. In Hebrews' Greek text it is *He* who is coming. What does Habakkuk's setting (waiting through judgment for Yahweh's answer) bring forward for the readers' endurance?
b) Hab 2:4 in Hebrew contrasts the proud; the Greek Hebrews uses reads “if anyone draws back.” What does that bring forward into 10:38–39?
